ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus Group AppleJeus/Operation Dream Job — trojanized cryptocurrency/trading app spawning LOLBin download chain
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus Group / Hidden Cobra (DPRK, G0032) tradecraft seen in AppleJeus and Operation Dream Job: a signed-but-trojanized cryptocurrency trading client or recruiter-themed lure executable (CelasTrade, JMTTrading, Manuscrypt, BLINDINGCAN dropper) runs from a user-writable path and immediately invokes certutil/curl/bitsadmin/regsvr32 to stage a second-stage implant. This actor-specific child chain plus the social-engineering parent paths is the differentiating signal versus generic LOLBin abuse.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_hash) as process_hash values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_process from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("CelasTradePro.exe","JMTTrader.exe","WorldBit-Bot.exe","UnionCryptoTrader.exe","CryptoNeuro Trader.exe","Kupay Wallet.exe","Ant2Whale.exe","DAFOM.exe") OR (Processes.parent_process_path IN ("*\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*","*\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("*Trader*.exe","*Wallet*.exe","*Crypto*.exe","*Bridge*.exe","BLINDINGCAN*.exe")) Processes.process_name IN ("certutil.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","mshta.exe") (Processes.process="*-urlcache*" OR Processes.process="*-decode*" OR Processes.process="*transfer*http*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*://*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus AppleJeus / Dream Job — trojanized crypto/recruiter binary chaining to LOLBin staging
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LazarusLureNames = dynamic(["celastradepro.exe","jmttrader.exe","worldbit-bot.exe","unioncryptotrader.exe","cryptoneuro trader.exe","kupay wallet.exe","ant2whale.exe","dafom.exe","blindingcan.exe"]);
let LazarusLureSubstrings = dynamic(["trader","wallet","crypto","bridge","defi","coin","amazon_assessment","job_description","sdet_assignment"]);
let StagingLOLBins = dynamic(["certutil.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ (StagingLOLBins)
| where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LazarusLureNames))
     or (InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\")
         and InitiatingProcessFileName has_any (LazarusLureSubstrings)
         and InitiatingProcessFileName endswith ".exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-urlcache","-decode","transfer http","DownloadString","FromBase64String","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","Invoke-WebRequest","http://","https://")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          LureParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          LureParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          LureParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          LureParentSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          ChildLOLBin = FileName,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256 = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "\\")[-1]))

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus AppleJeus/Dream Job Trojanized Lure Spawns Staging LOLBin
id: 8b5d0e2c-1a47-4f1a-9b14-2e0bafef0c11
status: experimental
description: Detects Lazarus Group / Hidden Cobra trojanized cryptocurrency trader or recruiter lure executables (AppleJeus, BLINDINGCAN dropper) spawning certutil/curl/bitsadmin/regsvr32/powershell with download or decode arguments.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa21-048a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-urlcache'
      - '-decode'
      - 'transfer http'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
  selection_parent_known:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\CelasTradePro.exe'
      - '\JMTTrader.exe'
      - '\WorldBit-Bot.exe'
      - '\UnionCryptoTrader.exe'
      - '\Kupay Wallet.exe'
      - '\Ant2Whale.exe'
      - '\DAFOM.exe'
  selection_parent_heuristic_path:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Public\'
  selection_parent_heuristic_name:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - 'Trader'
      - 'Wallet'
      - 'Crypto'
      - 'Bridge'
      - 'DeFi'
      - 'Coin'
      - 'job_description'
      - 'sdet_assignment'
      - 'amazon_assessment'
  condition: selection_child and selection_cmd and (selection_parent_known or (selection_parent_heuristic_path and selection_parent_heuristic_name))
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate cryptocurrency trading software downloading updates
  - IT install scripts in user temp paths
level: high

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 3CX/X_TRADER supply-chain — signed but unsigned-by-vendor application loading sideloaded DLL with C2 beacon
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima supply-chain tradecraft from the 3CXDesktopApp (SmoothOperator) and X_TRADER (VEILEDSIGNAL) campaigns: a legitimately-installed enterprise client (3CXDesktopApp.exe, ffmpeg.dll host, X_TRADER.exe) sideloads a malicious DLL that immediately beacons to a Lazarus C2 infrastructure pattern (icon-encoded GitHub-hosted second-stage URL or known SmoothOperator domains). Differentiates from generic DLL-sideload detections by anchoring on the actor's exact host-binary/DLL pairs and the post-load network IOC family.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip values(All_Traffic.app) as app from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.process_name IN ("3CXDesktopApp.exe","X_TRADER.exe","Trading Technologies XTrader.exe") AND (All_Traffic.dest IN ("akamaicontainer.com","akamaitechcloudservices.com","azuredeploystore.com","azureonlinecloud.com","azureonlinestorage.com","dunamistrd.com","glcloudservice.com","journalide.org","msedgepackageinfo.com","msstorageazure.com","msstorageboxes.com","officeaddons.com","officestoragebox.com","pbxcloudeservices.com","pbxphonenetwork.com","pbxsources.com","qwepoi123098.com","sbmsa.wiki","sourceslabs.com","visualstudiofactory.com","zacharryblogs.com","raw.githubusercontent.com") OR match(All_Traffic.url,".*\.ico$") ) by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.url | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus / Diamond Sleet 3CX (SmoothOperator) + X_TRADER (VEILEDSIGNAL) supply-chain compromise
// Anchors on the actor-specific host binary AND known C2 domain set, plus the GitHub icon-hosted second-stage retrieval pattern
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let LazarusHostBinaries = dynamic(["3cxdesktopapp.exe","x_trader.exe","trading technologies xtrader.exe"]);
let LazarusSideloadedDlls = dynamic(["ffmpeg.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","winscard.dll","iconv.dll"]);
let SmoothOperatorC2 = dynamic([
    "akamaicontainer.com","akamaitechcloudservices.com","azuredeploystore.com",
    "azureonlinecloud.com","azureonlinestorage.com","dunamistrd.com",
    "glcloudservice.com","journalide.org","msedgepackageinfo.com",
    "msstorageazure.com","msstorageboxes.com","officeaddons.com",
    "officestoragebox.com","pbxcloudeservices.com","pbxphonenetwork.com",
    "pbxsources.com","qwepoi123098.com","sbmsa.wiki","sourceslabs.com",
    "visualstudiofactory.com","zacharryblogs.com"]);
let SideloadEvents = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LazarusHostBinaries)
    | where FileName in~ (LazarusSideloadedDlls)
    | where not(FolderPath has_any (@"\Program Files\3CXDesktopApp\", @"\Program Files (x86)\3CXDesktopApp\")
                and SHA256 in ((externaldata(h:string)[@"https://example/empty.txt"] with (format="txt"))))  // placeholder: replace with allowlist of known-good vendor DLL hashes
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              HostBin = InitiatingProcessFileName, DllName = FileName,
              DllPath = FolderPath, DllSHA256 = SHA256,
              InitiatingProcessId;
let NetworkBeacons = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LazarusHostBinaries)
    | where (RemoteUrl has_any (SmoothOperatorC2))
         or (RemoteUrl has "raw.githubusercontent.com" and RemoteUrl endswith ".ico")
         or (RemoteUrl endswith ".ico" and RemoteIPType == "Public");
SideloadEvents
| join kind=inner (NetworkBeacons) on DeviceId
| where Timestamp1 between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 1h)
| project SideloadTime = Timestamp, BeaconTime = Timestamp1,
          DeviceName, HostBin, DllName, DllPath, SHA256,
          BeaconUrl = RemoteUrl, BeaconIP = RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by SideloadTime desc

// Lazarus / Diamond Sleet 3CX + X_TRADER supply-chain — host-binary network egress to known C2 set
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let LazarusHostBinaries = dynamic(["3cxdesktopapp.exe","x_trader.exe","trading technologies xtrader.exe"]);
let SmoothOperatorC2 = dynamic([
    "akamaicontainer.com","akamaitechcloudservices.com","azuredeploystore.com",
    "azureonlinecloud.com","azureonlinestorage.com","dunamistrd.com",
    "glcloudservice.com","journalide.org","msedgepackageinfo.com",
    "msstorageazure.com","msstorageboxes.com","officeaddons.com",
    "officestoragebox.com","pbxcloudeservices.com","pbxphonenetwork.com",
    "pbxsources.com","qwepoi123098.com","sbmsa.wiki","sourceslabs.com",
    "visualstudiofactory.com","zacharryblogs.com"]);
let NetSession = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend SrcImageLower = tolower(tostring(SrcUsername))
    | extend DstHostLower = tolower(DstHostname)
    | extend UrlLower = tolower(Url)
    | where (DstHostLower has_any (SmoothOperatorC2))
         or (UrlLower has "raw.githubusercontent.com" and UrlLower endswith ".ico")
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, Url, DstPortNumber;
let DnsSession = ImDnsActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DnsQuery has_any (SmoothOperatorC2)
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DnsQuery, SrcIpAddr;
let ProcCtx = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend ActingName = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ActingName in (LazarusHostBinaries)
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActingName, ActingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
ProcCtx
| join kind=inner (NetSession) on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 1h)
| project ProcTime, BeaconTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
          HostBinary = ActingName, ActingProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
          DstHostname, Url, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber
| order by BeaconTime desc
